7.5 SLEEP Phase
Refer to Section 7.1.4 SLEEP Phase for an overview of the SLEEP phase.
EcuM_-
GoDownHaltPoll
with shutdown target SLEEP initiate the SLEEP phase.
EcuM_GoDownHaltPoll
with shutdown target SLEEP initiate two control streams,
depending on the sleep mode selected (EcuMSleepModeSuspend parameter), that
differ structurally in the mechanisms used to realize sleep. They share the sequences
for preparing for and recovering from sleep, however.
